hatim.bio: A transmitter associated with Medina. Ibn Ḥajar records death in 186 or 187 AH.
as: His written material was sound. He was truthful and sometimes made mistakes.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
حاتم بن إسماعيل أحب إلي من الدراوردي، زعموا أن حاتما كان فيه غفلة، إلا أن كتابه صالح
I prefer Ḥātim to al-Darāwardī. People say Ḥātim was inattentive, but his written collection is sound.
Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
هو أحب إلي من سعيد بن سالم
I prefer him to Saʿīd ibn Sālim.
Reliable and trustworthy, and transmitted many hadiths.
He was reliable and trustworthy, and transmitted many hadiths.
